dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Just as knowledge is often acquired only through hands-on learning, victory is usually secured by overcoming a challenge.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: In that sense, domain explorers are knowledge seekers too, just with a different methodology.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Of course, it's not suited to everyone. I'd encourage people to stick to their own areas of expertise.
